environment: candidate checkout and the assembled pinned xverse-platform target; offline, Python 3.11+; no reparse of source YAML/JSON and no wall-clock dependence.
expected: The plan exposes independent plan/Profile/schema/resource/artifact version dimensions and the semantic digest; equivalent YAML/JSON encodings and input permutations produce equal canonical plan bytes and equal plan digests, while byte hashes and volatile run data stay outside the semantic identity.
intended_use: A downstream consumer verifies plan version, Profile version/hash, API version and the normalized input semantic digest from the resolved plan without reparsing the YAML/JSON sources, and compares equivalent encodings and input permutations.
title: Downstream consumer verifies versions and hashes without reparsing YAML
